stem: A sphere is inscribed in a cube, so the sphere touches all six faces of the cube. The surface area of the cube is \(384\). The volume of the sphere is \(k\pi\). What is the value of \(k\)?
solution: Each face of the cube has area \(384 \div 6 = 64\), so the edge length is 8.
The sphere's diameter equals the edge length, so its radius is 4.
verify:
s=sqrt(Rational(384,6))
assert s==8
k=Rational(4,3)*(s/2)**3
assert k==Rational(256,3)
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==k and len(spr_answers)==1
